title: Race.mx Mexican Motorsport Open Data
description: Year-by-year winners of Mexico's major races (Formula 1 Mexican Grand Prix since 1962, Baja 1000 since 1967, Baja 500 since 2010, Mexico City E-Prix, NASCAR Mexico Series champions since 2004), the current season's race calendar, and venue data. Every figure is taken from an official source or two independent reputable outlets; source pages are linked in the data. Live versions: https://race.mx/open-data/
